description: ChildNutri AI Authoritative Model & Artifact Manifest

ensemble.name: Soft-Voting Tabular Ensemble (XGB 40% + LGB 35% + RF 25%)
ensemble.clinical_status: Validated on development dataset. Provides primary screening classification.
ensemble.limitations: Trained on development dataset; requires external multicenter validation for real-world clinical deployment.

neonatal_regressor.name: EfficientNet-B0 Indian Neonatal Anthropometric Regressor

dataset_attribution.dataset_name: Neonatal Anthropometric Image Dataset for Computer Vision-Based Growth Analysis
clinical_sites: Combined District Hospital, Manjhanpur, Kaushambi, UP, India
dataset_attribution.permitted_use: Research, academic, and educational use only

neonatal_regressor.clinical_status: Experimental research prototype trained on real clinically acquired Indian neonatal photographic dataset. Multi-target anthropometric estimation with subject-level zero-leakage partitions.

evaluation_evidence.partition: Held-out subject test set (N=8 subjects, 25 images)
evaluation_evidence.summary: Weight MAE 656.8g (R2 = -0.12), Body length MAE 1.90cm (R2 = -0.15), Head circumference MAE 1.65cm (R2 = 0.29)

neonatal_regressor.limitations: Screening decision-support research prototype based on single/multi-view 2D photos (cohort size N=83). Exhibits regression-to-the-mean on low-birth-weight neonates. Does not replace calibrated physical clinical infantometer and baby weighing scale.

vision.name: EfficientNet-B0 Malnutrition Feature Extractor
vision.clinical_status: Architectural prototype for under-5 pediatric triage.
vision.limitations: Research prototype; continuous neonatal regression is handled by neonatal_regressor.

multimodal_fusion.name: 1292-D Multimodal Feature Fusion Network
multimodal_fusion.input_breakdown: 1280 visual embedding features + 12 anthropometric clinical features
multimodal_fusion.clinical_status: Architectural research prototype. Demonstrates cross-modal attention gating.
multimodal_fusion.limitations: Experimental prototype architecture; demonstrates cross-modal attention gating. Labels in development scripts were derived heuristically from birth weight with known target leakage on a 25-sample test set; not validated as an independent clinical diagnostic model.
multimodal_fusion.evaluation_note: Reported 100% benchmark in all_models_metrics.json was an exploratory prototype artifact due to synthetic weight-derived labels on 25 test items; not a clinically validated performance metric.

anthropometric_legacy.name: Legacy Anthropometric Model Wrapper (Quarantined)
anthropometric_legacy.notice: Never used for production screening. Replaced by ensemble_model.pkl.
